title: Team Composition
text: Teams must consist of 2 to 4 members. Interdisciplinary and multi-college teams are permitted.

title: Student Eligibility
text: Open to all students currently enrolled in recognized colleges, polytechnics, or universities across India.

title: Registration Gate
text: All team members must be registered via the official Google Form prior to the deadline.

title: Round 1 Online Mode
text: Round 1 is fully online. Teams must submit idea synopses, system design, and demonstration videos/code repositories.

title: Round 2 On-Campus
text: Shortlisted teams will be invited to the physical hackathon at Dayalbagh Educational Institute, Agra.

title: Complimentary Stay
text: Accommodation for the offline finals is provided by DEI for all shortlisted outstation team members.

title: Track Alignment
text: Projects must target one of the announced problem statements / tracks or propose a novel virtual lab simulation.

title: Original Work & OSS
text: Code must be developed during the hackathon. Standard open-source libraries are permitted with proper attribution.

title: Academic Integrity
text: Plagiarism, submission of pre-built commercial software, or code theft will lead to immediate disqualification.

title: Judicial Finality
text: Decisions of the joint DEI x VLABS evaluation jury are final and binding on all participating teams.
